title: Jutta P NDE 4971
content: While my Dengue fever rose I was like comatose, I saw grotesque faces and hobgoblins who wanted; summon me to dance so they could take away the air to breath. I fled into a dark tunnel to hide which suddenly opened in front of me. I went further because I saw light in the distance. The nearer I came to the light, I felt lighter, calmer, and happier - and somehow snug. The Light got brighter, my body felt slight and an overwhelming feeling of freedom and floating passed through me, it was miraculous and I can't forget it. It was a garden made of light. I didn't see a silhouette of people, but I saw light moving. I could imagine them as angels and before I went to step in, a soft voice talked to me that my time was not up and my soul wanted to finish its life-task. A door shut and I was surrounded in darkness again. I was still in this tunnel, but I went out calmed down. I awoke two days later and it felt like awaking from a dream, from each hour to hour I was getting better. Since then I hear voices of souls from other people. I get messages from my ancestors and I feel totally loved and supported. The messages of other souls are always verified. The message I got lead to my mission: to accompany dying children and pass the happy soul-messages from the children to their bereaved and families.

arrival.other_being_detail: Initially saw “grotesque faces and hobgoblins” that tried to summon her to dance and “take away the air to breath.” Later heard “a soft voice” saying her time was not up.

environment.environment_other_detail: “a garden made of light” and “light moving.”

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: “A door shut and I was surrounded in darkness again… still in this tunnel, but I went out calmed down.”
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: “to accompany dying children and pass the happy soul-messages from the children to their bereaved and families.”

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Threatening “grotesque faces and hobgoblins” at the onset; later “a door shut” returning her to darkness/tunnel.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Distressing beings first, then flight into tunnel, then light/garden, then boundary (door/voice) and return to tunnel/darkness.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Initial encounter with “grotesque faces and hobgoblins” who tried to summon her to dance and take away her breath; boundary described as “a door shut.”
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “It was a garden made of light.”; “my time was not up and my soul wanted to finish its life-task.”; “Since then I hear voices of souls from other people… The messages of other souls are always verified.”
